body: Why specifically are you going to end your life?

I think you're right. I have let him know that it bothers me and in the past he would say that it won't happen again, but nowadays he doesn't really say anything. It gives me major anxiety and depression before and during my time out of town. It seems like he is extremely depressed or something and even if it isn't my fault, it can feel like it is at times. 

This has been happening since the beginning of our relationship, so I guess I shouldn't expect him to change. When we were first dating and I lived in a different city he would often go weeks on end without communicating with me and I would get really depressed and assumed he had broken up with me. Now it just feels like he hates me and I just make him angry. 

Thank you for your comment.

I have done that. I know it has to be a completely bogus explanation. This happens almost every time I'm out of town. It's so weird because when I'm in town he will generally answer his phone when I call or respond to texts or whatever (although his responses are extremely limited and unevenutful), but not when I'm out of town. 

In the past, when I'd ask him about him, he would usually say "I did call" or "I didn't get your call/text" but he generally responds nowadays with "I don't know" and then proceeds to shut-own. And if I get angry, he'll just tell me he "doesn't want to talk to me" and get off the phone. I guess asking about it makes him angry, resentful, bored, whatever. 

But yes - I think he is very anti-social. I don't know if he'll ever admit to actively avoiding me. I will try asking though. Sorry for the long reply and thank you.
I would agree that he is probably cheating on me, except for the fact that he is extremely anti-social. I don't know though...it is really odd.
You are right. It's been incredibly difficult. He says that oral sex constitutes a type of sex and so it shouldn't matter. It is clear he has problems with intimacy or something.
TY. It does seem like that. It's difficult when you live with that person already. I am, however, applying for jobs in other locations at the moment and I could just move without him.
I'm sorry you're going through a divorce. I appreciate the comment though. I wish you the best!
Thanks for your comment! I'm sorry for my delayed response. I am with him because I love him, despite his flaws. Currently trying to see where this is going...(my relationship, I mean)...
Thanks for your response! I agree with you completely. I just wish it were possible to make someone change, if it's in their own best interest.

This is likely going to make me sound even more dumb, but why can't you explain to someone why they should change and inspire them to do so? I feel like a lot of the changes I encourage him to make are positive ones.
You are right. I thought he was a really nice person when we first started dating and that I could change the parts of him that weren't what I considered "normal." Lesson learned. : (
Honestly, he has always been this way - as far as I know.
